inspection_method: Individually opened all five actual PNG files using view_image with original detail, read the receipt, and independently recomputed the receipt and PNG SHA256 hashes. Also checked all eleven receipt source hashes against current files. No engine was run during this review.

capture_parameters_from_receipt.note: The receipt reports unfocusable=false. This review does not claim the minimized native root was unfocusable or establish operating-system focus behavior.

overview_inspections.visible_capability_text: Air: one paid double jump; no flight.
overview_inspections.selection_visual: Hobbit card has the gold selected border and tinted fill; right-hand title, miniature and statistics match S. Wayne. Footer says Attunement unavailable, while the background HUD still identifies Oh Tipi.
overview_inspections.readability: Capability line is fully readable in gold below the five stat rows. No overlap or clipping observed in the selected card, title, capability, statistics or footer at native size.

overview_inspections.visible_capability_text: Air: one paid double jump; no flight.
overview_inspections.selection_visual: Selected Seakin card is marked EQUIPPED, its matching overview says Oh Tipi, and the lower button says Already equipped. This is visibly distinct from merely inspecting another character.
overview_inspections.readability: All five stat rows, air-action note and saved-weave note are readable without overlap. Equipped card status replaces the size caption on the card, but Middle remains explicit in the overview.

overview_inspections.visible_capability_text: Air: one paid double jump; no flight.
overview_inspections.selection_visual: Undead card and right-hand preview identify The Red Baron; the lower button remains Attunement unavailable. Large hurt radius and slower walk speed are legible alongside greater Health and Stamina reserves.
overview_inspections.readability: The longer character name remains on one readable line in both its card and detail header. No capability, table or footer clipping observed. Neighboring Leaf the Hidden and Trevor the Mason names deliberately wrap to two lines within their cards.

overview_inspections.visible_capability_text: Air: paid flight up to 2.4 s; no double jump.
overview_inspections.selection_visual: Sylph card is selected, and its winged portrait and miniature match the Grace Riva title. Attunement remains unavailable; no screenshot suggests the inspected character was equipped.
overview_inspections.readability: The longer paid-flight sentence fits on one line, including the 2.4 s cap and no-double-jump trade-off. It is visually distinct from the other three air-action notes and does not overlap the comparison or saved-weave lines.

starter_detail_inspection.readability: The twelve visible detail lines are readable in light cream on the dark panel, with no glyph clipping or overlap into the page indicator or navigation buttons. Pagination, not drawing overflow, truncates the prose context.
starter_detail_inspection.visible_first_line: Bolts, one Heavy for the strongest affinity
starter_detail_inspection.visible_last_line: weave unchanged. Use the Spell Loom's
visible_composition_claims: One Heavy for the strongest affinity, first listed on a tie.
All twelve positions can be customized at the Spell Loom.
starter_detail_inspection.missing_visible_composition: The eight element Bolts count and the beginning of the starter-composition sentence are on an uncaptured preceding page. The words twelve-slot starter on this captured page belong to the later saved-weave fallback sentence, not the start of the composition sentence.
visible_saved_weave_claims: Attuning preserves resource percentages and restores this character's saved weave, or its twelve-slot starter if uncustomized.
Online weave restoration waits for host confirmation; the Spell Loom shows currently equipped spells.
Selecting the current character leaves its weave unchanged.
starter_detail_inspection.additional_partial_sentence: The explicit Spell Loom starter-preview explanation continues after the screenshot's final line and is not fully visually accepted.
starter_detail_inspection.receipt_alignment: The fragment filename, complete=false and missing eight element Bolts phrase accurately describe this screenshot. Five of six phrase matches do not establish a complete composition paragraph.

shared_visual_findings.layout: All five Gallery panels fit inside the native frame with a visible outer border. Race navigation, card columns, selected-card outline, preview title, detail navigation and lower status row remain separate. No visible overlap or clipped text was found in the four overviews or the twelve rendered detail lines.
shared_visual_findings.contrast: Qualitative native-size inspection: primary cream text and gold capability text are readable on the dark panel. Muted regeneration values and controller hints are smaller and less prominent but still readable in these frames. No numeric contrast-ratio, low-vision or reduced-resolution acceptance is claimed.
shared_visual_findings.resource_tradeoffs: The actual numbers communicate the Small/Middle/Large reserve, pace and hurt-radius differences. All four screens explicitly retain wall: 18 px, avoiding an implied wider wall-clearance requirement for Large. Grace and S. Wayne both say Small but show different real resources and speed rather than claiming size alone fixes every stat.
shared_visual_findings.saved_weave_overview_text: All four overviews visibly say Attune: saved weave; starter if uncustomized. The bottom instruction also names Enter / A. This is text-readability evidence only, not functional restoration evidence.
shared_visual_findings.selection_semantics: Gold selected cards and the right-hand content follow the inspected identity. Oh Tipi alone shows EQUIPPED and Already equipped. Other inspected identities show Attunement unavailable, with Stand beside the Gallery to attune explaining the service requirement. The receipt records Oh Tipi as equipped and pending_wire=0 throughout.
shared_visual_findings.controller_hints: Arrow/WASD/D-pad inspection, Enter/A attune, page/bumper race navigation and detail/facing hints are visible in the lower help rows without overlap. Physical controller navigation was not performed.
shared_visual_findings.art_scope: Existing portraits and preview miniatures are visible and match these four selected identities. Character art was unchanged in this batch; these screenshots do not accept all thirty identities, animation cycles or directional art.

authority_evidence_from_receipt.qualification: Read from the passed scripted capture receipt and consistent with visible selection labels; this reviewer did not execute authority or attunement tests.

followup.finding: Starter prose begins and ends mid-sentence on Detail 3 / 4, forcing page navigation to understand the full composition and starter-preview rule.
followup.bounded_next_option: If complete starter visual acceptance is required, capture both adjacent production pages or later improve paragraph-aware pagination. Do not relabel the present fragment as a complete twelve-slot starter screenshot.

not_accepted: Whole-roster visual quality or newly authored character art.
Native attunement, saved-weave restoration or network confirmation behavior.
Physical keyboard, mouse or controller operation.
Movement, flight, wall-jump or spell execution.
Complete starter-composition or starter-preview prose on a single captured page.
Low-resolution, accessibility contrast, operating-system focus, multiplayer or performance acceptance.
Human playtest, subjective fun, release promotion or publication.
